newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar ends flat at 480.75/481.75 dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar ends flat at 480.75/481.75 dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed little changed against the dollar at 480.75/481.75 on Monday as the Central Bank covered corporate demand for dollars, traders said.
The unit closed at 480.60/481.00 per dollar on Friday.
At one point in a fairly active market, the bolivar reached 482 but "it closed lower because the Central Bank intervened sufficiently to maintain a certain stability," one trader said.
He added that today's exchange rate is the level that the bank wants to see at the end of the month.
